manual_visual_review.method: All current endpoint sheets and forty sampled motion frames per chapter inspected, with native-frame checks of repaired formulas, replay dates and transitions. Reviewed sheet hashes must match the final artifacts.
focused_repairs: Hypothetical dollar-call experiment priced with a DVOL proxy; retrospective window selection, overlapping observations, timing and execution limitations
Self-financing hedge gains, continuous robust-hedging assumptions and dependent leading martingale differences
Local consistency versus convergence; finite-window and vertically rescaled heat-kernel illustration
Exact jump remainder versus quadratic approximation; lognormal jump-risk proxy is not a Merton variance-floor theorem
Round-trip versus one-way cost convention and bounded call prices at diverging Leland volatility
Surface IV reconstructed from mark prices; numerical round trip, strict price bounds and low-vega conditioning
Coin premium, undiscounted forward value and spot-dollar present value; carry and discount conventions
American weak lower bound at zero rates, 600-step curves versus displayed 2000-step price, BAW approximation
Full recorded solver and neural overshoots, all five neural seeds, omitted invalid Newton dots and sentinel diagnostics
Full histogram ranges and common count scales; fixed screen-space bars under the 3D camera
1987 pre-return states, held stock weights and the October-end date matched to cached observations and narration cues
Comparison axes and baseline table rows appear during their explanation; caption columns fit; dense lattice holds steady after a short orbit
Brownian exit-time assumptions, Fukasawa admissibility and expected quadratic variation, retrospective band tuning and visible worked answer
2026 preprint claims and historical industry figures checked against primary sources
Missing Mandarin captions and decimal-template ambiguity repaired; deterministic-coefficient exercise distinguished from stochastic theorem
